narrative:
## Handover Summary — Revenue Targets

FY2026 net sales targets are locked at the therapy-area, brand-indication and market level and cascaded to every planning cell.

## Key Decisions
• Neurology envelope raised on Ultomiris gMG new-patient momentum
• Metabolic lifted on adult HPP diagnosis programme evidence
• Hematology held — Soliris erosion and Voydeya add-on are modelled in Launch & Lifecycle

## Recommendation for Patient Volume
The Patient Insights Lead should validate that treated-patient curves support the Neurology and Metabolic targets, especially gMG diagnosis-to-treatment time and HPP screening conversion.
